question: It is hot outside. It is cloudy and raining most of the time. It is the month of June. Which season is it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monsoon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The month of June typically marks the beginning of the monsoon season in many parts of the world, especially in countries like India.
 
• Monsoon is characterized by heavy rains and cloudy skies, which matches the description provided.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monsoon **season generally occurs from **June to September** in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It is a crucial season for agriculture, as it provides the necessary rainfall for crops.
 
• Monsoon winds bring moisture from the Indian Ocean, leading to widespread rainfall.
